params.name: topicId
params.description: ID of the Topic.

params.name: from
params.description: Filter mentions published on or after this date. Format - `yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss`, with an optional UTC offset. Without an offset the value is interpreted in the `timeZone` parameter's zone, which defaults to the API key owner's time zone (see *Dates and time zones* in the Mentions section). Default - 6 days before today.

params.name: to
params.description: Filter mentions published till the `to` date, **inclusive**: the effective upper bound is `to` plus one day. `to=2018-06-08` includes the whole of June 8; `to=2018-06-08T04:20Z` includes mentions up to (but excluding) June 9, 04:20Z. Format and time zone interpretation are the same as for `from`. Default - today.

params.name: addedFrom
params.description: Filter mentions that were added to the topic after this date. Format - `yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss`. Unlike `published`, this is the moment YouScan saved the mention — useful for catching mentions collected with a delay. Note: unlike `to`, `addedTo` is not extended by a day.

params.name: addedTo
params.description: Filter mentions that were added to the topic before this date. Format - `yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss`.

params.name: sinceSeq
params.description: Cursor filter: return only mentions with `seq` greater than this value (exclusive). Combine with `orderBy=seqAsc` and pass the highest `seq` from the previous page — see *How to effectively retrieve large sets of mentions* for the full loop.

params.name: sentiment
params.description: Filter mentions matching the specified sentiment. Multiple values are supported.

params.name: excludeSentiment
params.description: Exclude mentions matching the specified sentiment. Multiple values are supported.

params.name: engagementFrom
params.description: Filter mentions with engagement count greater than or equal to this value.

params.name: engagementTo
params.description: Filter mentions with engagement count less than or equal to this value.

params.name: engagementCollectedFrom
params.description: Filter mentions where engagement data was collected after this date. Format - `yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss`.

params.name: engagementCollectedTo
params.description: Filter mentions where engagement data was collected before this date. Format - `yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss`.

params.name: sources
params.description: Filter mentions by source. Multiple values are supported.

params.name: excludeSources
params.description: Exclude mentions by source. Multiple values are supported.

params.name: sourceTypes
params.description: Filter mentions by source type. Multiple values are supported.

params.name: excludeSourceTypes
params.description: Exclude mentions by source type. Multiple values are supported.

params.name: postTypes
params.description: Filter mentions by post type. Multiple values are supported.

params.name: excludePostTypes
params.description: Exclude mentions by post type. Multiple values are supported.

params.name: tags
params.description: Filter mentions by tag names. Multiple values are supported. Returns a validation error if a tag with the given name does not exist in the topic.

params.name: excludeTags
params.description: Exclude mentions by tag names. Multiple values are supported.

params.name: autoCategories
params.description: Filter mentions by [auto categories](https://youscan.io/2018/04/wom-autocategory/). Multiple values are supported.

params.name: excludeAutoCategories
params.description: Exclude mentions by [auto categories](https://youscan.io/2018/04/wom-autocategory/). Multiple values are supported.

params.name: starred
params.description: Use `true` to get only starred mentions.

params.name: tagged
params.description: Use `true` to get mentions containing any tag. Use `false` to get mentions without any tags. Omit the parameter to get all mentions regardless of tags.

params.name: processed
params.description: Use `true` to get processed mentions. Use `false` to get unprocessed mentions. Omit the parameter to get all mentions regardless of processed status.

params.name: deleted
params.description: Use `true` to get mentions that were moved to Bin.

params.name: spam
params.description: Use `true` to get mentions that were marked as spam.

params.name: textQuery
params.description: Additionally filter mentions by a text query using YouScan query syntax.

params.name: dedup
params.description: Use `true` to group near-duplicate mentions by text and return only one mention per group.

params.name: htmlSanitize
params.description: Whether to sanitize mention text to be consumed as HTML. Use `false` to get raw unescaped text.

params.name: timeZone
params.description: IANA time zone identifier (e.g. `Europe/Kyiv`) used to interpret date parameters that have no explicit offset. Defaults to the API key owner's time zone. To reproduce the numbers a platform user sees in the UI, pass that user's time zone here.

params.name: size
params.description: Limits the number of mentions per page. Default - 10, maximum - 1000. The response `total` field tells how many mentions match in total — if it exceeds `size`, paginate with the `sinceSeq` cursor.

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of mentions to skip. Used for paging; must be less than 10000. To page deeper than that, use the `sinceSeq` cursor instead.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Sorting field.

items.docs:
Use this action to retrieve mentions matching criteria.

This endpoint is rate limited: no more than 10 requests per 10 seconds and no more than
5 concurrent requests per user. Requests beyond those limits are rejected with a 429 status code.

params.name: topicId
params.description: ID of the Topic.

params.name: ids
params.description: Mention IDs. Multiple values are supported. Maximum 500 IDs per request.

params.name: timeZone
params.description: IANA time zone identifier used to convert mention dates in the response. Defaults to the API key owner's time zone.

items.docs: Retrieve specific mentions by their IDs. Maximum 500 IDs per request.

params.name: topicId
params.description: ID of the Topic.

items.docs: Same as the GET variant, but accepts the IDs in the request body — useful when the list of IDs is too long for a URL. Maximum 500 IDs per request.

params.description: ID of the Topic.

items.docs: Update mentions' `tags` and `sentiment`, mark them as spam, or remove them. Maximum 100 mentions per request.
